name: Reaper: The Time Has Come raises ability damage by 10% against slowed enemies
contract: The Time Has Come 572879 is a Reaper talent (CharacterAdvancement 34477: ClassType 32 = class 30 Reaper, tab 79 'Reaping', 1 talent essence; mod-spellbook lists it in the Reaper tree). It reads 'Your abilities now deal $s1% more damage against slowed targets.' Its only effect is aura 112 with EffectMiscValue 20007 (the class-mask aura-state damage selector), EffectMiscValueB 26, EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10 and EffectSpellClassMask [677413671, 2449487953, 4472960] in family 36, which covers Murder 500376 (family word 1 bit 64) and Soul Strike 500517 (word 1 bit 2048) but not Soulspear 803984 (no family flags). State 26 is ASCENSION_TARGET_SLOWED, which Unit::HasAuraState reads as SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED, the same selector and state as Black Hole 707557 and Felsworn's Reckless Assault 804610, whose tooltips also say 'against slowed'. Nothing converted 572879's aura 112, so the talent changed nothing. The query is the native spell_damage_done (Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone folds aura 303 into the done multiplier) against two identical dummies, only one of which carries a mage's Slow 31589 (aura 33 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED). Expected: before the talent the slow changes nothing; with it Murder and Soul Strike deal exactly 10% more against the slowed dummy only, and Soulspear, outside the mask, gains nothing.
